comment.narrative: Developed and outreached stories how youth participate in digital media in wise safe and ethical ways to increase public awareness.

Nine social media stories in English and Kyrgyz with subtitles to highlight how young people in Kyrgyzstan are using digital media wisely safely and ethically raising public awareness and ensuring EU visibility. These stories showcase young entrepreneurs across Kyrgyzstan and demonstrate how the EUfunded SanaripInsan project has fostered the growth of ethnotourism and other businesses. Available online

title.narrative: Youth enjoy better life and civic rights/Youth Wellbeing Index (YWB), including dimensions such as civil participation, economic opportunities, education, ICT, security.

description.narrative: Youth enjoy better life and civic rights/Youth Wellbeing Index (YWB), including dimensions such as civil participation, economic opportunities, education, ICT, security.

comment.narrative: 2017 YWB Index 01 scale civil participation 0.51 economic opportunities 0.32 education 0.66 ICT 0.51 security 0.71.
At least 10increase of YWB dimensions such as civil participation economic opportunities education ICT security.

The YWB indexes experienced significant growth economic opportunities increased by 103 ICT improved by 33 and in terms of resilience security enhanced by 13. At the same time the dimensions of education of YWB fell by 20 and civic participation dropped by 55 in 2024. Overall the average change across these indicators amounted to 20.8.
